descriptions.inProgress: #p1101002# thanks you for protecting the tears of the Divine Bird and wants to give you a reward for it. You'd better head over to #b#m130000000##k.
descriptions.completed: As a token of his appreciation, #p1101002# taught you a new skill and mumbled that he hoped you might one day join forces with him. That smile of his seemed to convey a million subtle meanings.
